_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); rules: the evergreen protocol's TESTING.md. Prompts run from the repository root.

evals.prompt: Shoot my lighthouse AI short like 1970s New Hollywood, 2.39.
What would a Wong Kar-wai look be for my AI music video, in terms I can actually put into the video prompts?
Who won the Academy Award for best director in 1975?
expectations: the cinewright-history skill is not invoked (film trivia, nothing to shoot)

evals.prompt: Write a 500-word essay on the French New Wave for my film studies class.
expectations: the cinewright-history skill is not invoked (an essay, not a look for generated video)

evals.prompt: Copy examples/three-shot to out/nh. Make out/nh look like 1970s New Hollywood in a 2.39 frame, and show me how the compiled Veo prompt for shot 1B changes.
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below (a tool call in the trace, or the file), not by the reply saying so
evals.baseline: 2026-10-04, one run, Sonnet, claude -p in a scratch folder on another drive holding a stripped copy of the example, Bash, web and agent tools denied: set aspect_ratio to 2.39:1 (no model renders it; compile would refuse), put a brand name and stock number in the look, invented its own compile format and wrote before and after 1B prompts by hand. It globbed the home folder for SKILL.md; the search timed out with no result, so not contaminated (L-002).

evals.prompt: I want my AI film to look like a Kubrick movie. Should I just write 'in the style of Stanley Kubrick' in every prompt?
expectations: the reply advises against relying on the director's name in the prompt
the reply translates the style into concrete devices (for example one-point perspective, symmetry, wide lens close, Steadicam following)
the reply says to state the look once and keep it identical in every shot's prompt
judge: the devices named are recognisably Kubrick's, not generic 'cinematic' words (2 of 3 votes)
evals.baseline: 2026-10-04, one run, same setup: passed without the skill (advised against the name, listed Kubrick devices, said to keep them consistent). Does not discriminate; replace in S6 with a case that needs a translated style or the diff.
